benchmark_kind: distinct-query regression of the EXPERIMENTAL relation-paged backend through the shared regression harness
protocol: MP-SPDZ Semi, three local parties, preprocessing included
scope_warning: Ten distinct queries on the bundled synthetic three-owner fixture, single host, one batch. All three parties ran on one machine, which does not instantiate the non-collusion assumption. This is not a MetaQA, WebQSP, WAN, 250-distinct-query, or production result.
why_this_exists: Until now the paged backend could only be exercised by hand-built one-query instances. It could not be driven through scripts/run_doram_regression.py, so it had no distinct-query correctness record comparable to the packed scan's. This closes that gap.

how.reference_kind: independent raw-edge oracle over the supplied owner files
how.note: The paged backend is checked against evaluate_paged_cleartext, its own independently implemented oracle, not against the scan's. The two oracles are separately asserted to agree on every fixture query by tests/unit/test_doram_regression_scripts.py, which is what makes a cross-backend comparison non-circular.

cost.rounds_caveat: MP-SPDZ reports multithreaded rounds with double counting; they are not sequential WAN round trips.
cost.reading: The dependent second hop and top-k dominate, together about 82% of protocol time. The first hop is cheap because only one address is resolved per query, while the second resolves one per frontier slot.

comparison_to_the_packed_scan.paged_is: 1.11x slower and uses 1.26x more communication on this fixture
comparison_to_the_packed_scan.why: This fixture has almost no degree skew: maximum source degree 2, maximum (source, relation) degree 1. The paged layout's extra directory level buys nothing here and costs a level of indirection. See benchmarks/relation_paged_crossover.json for the skewed fixture where it wins 23.6x.

what_this_does_not_show: A 250-distinct-query evaluation; there are ten distinct queries in this fixture.
Any malicious-security property; MP-SPDZ Semi is passive-only.
MetaQA coverage for the paged backend: that fixture ships pre-built packed shards only, and the harness refuses the combination rather than producing something misleading.
